backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the ICP backend with types and logic for storing/retrieving control panel layouts, emitting button events, and querying recent events with a capped event log of 100 entries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two deployment-related features (Linux bundle packaging scripts and Linux setup documentation) to their associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one- to two-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose of components, hooks, utilities, and screens in the React control panel app.
frontend/docs/linux-local-test-bundle.md: Comprehensive setup guide for building the frontend static bundle, deploying the ICP backend canister locally with dfx, and serving the app via Apache alongside a GPIO signal receiver on port 3000.
frontend/docs/rpi-bash-runner.md: Documentation for the rpi_event_runner.sh script that polls the ICP backend for GPIO events and executes corresponding GPIO commands on a Raspberry Pi.
frontend/docs/rpi-bash-runner.md.backup: Empty backup file of the rpi-bash-runner documentation with no content.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining dark-theme OKLCH CSS custom properties, control panel-specific styles (lit state, fullscreen workspace), and custom scrollbar styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite React app, setting the page title to 'Pair of Dice Control panel' and mounting the app at the #root div.
frontend/INSTALL.md: Linux installation guide listing prerequisites (dfx, Node.js, Apache, jq, gpiod) and providing a quick-start section for users with a pre-built tar.gz bundle.
frontend/README.md: Frontend README covering prerequisites and quick-start steps for building and serving the GPIO Control Panel with Apache HTTP Server.
Bash helper library providing a run_step function that executes named build/deploy commands and prints colorized diagnostic output including the last 100 lines of output on failure.
frontend/scripts/linux_bundle_run.sh: Linux bundle launcher script that starts a local ICP replica, deploys the control panel canister, and supports --stop, --clean, and --help flags with colorized step-by-step diagnostics on failure.
frontend/scripts/package_linux_bundle.sh: Bash script that builds the frontend and backend canister, then packages the artifacts into a timestamped .tar.gz bundle for Linux/Raspberry Pi distribution. Validates dependencies, runs build steps with diagnostics, and assembles the archive in the project root.
frontend/scripts/rpi_event_runner.env.ex: Example environment variable configuration file for the Raspberry Pi GPIO event runner script, documenting required (CANISTER_ID, NETWORK) and optional (DRY_RUN, POLL_INTERVAL, STATE_FILE, ALLOWED_PREFIX) settings.
frontend/scripts/rpi_event_runner.servic: Example systemd service unit file for running the GPIO event runner as a background service on a Raspberry Pi, with restart-on-failure behavior and optional security hardening directives.
frontend/scripts/rpi_event_runner.sh: Bash script that continuously polls a backend ICP canister for GPIO events and executes whitelisted gpioset commands on a Raspberry Pi, with dry-run support, state tracking to avoid duplicate execution, and configurable poll interval.
frontend/scripts/rpi_pin_test.sh: Bash script for verifying GPIO wiring on a Raspberry Pi by toggling pins 26, 6, 22, and 4 individually, supporting dry-run, interactive, and automatic cycling modes without requiring the ICP canister.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the application in a dark-mode ThemeProvider and renders the ControlPanelScreen alongside a Toaster notification component.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Ad: React modal dialog for creating new control panel controls, supporting button, toggle, slider, radio, and dial types with type-specific configuration fields and auto-generated decimal codes.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Co: React context provider that manages the control panel layout state, syncing with the backend canister via React Query for loading and saving layouts, and exposing CRUD operations for controls.
Renders individual control widgets (button, toggle, slider, radio, dial) and handles user interactions by emitting signals and sending GPIO HTTP commands with appropriate state tracking.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Cr: A button component that opens the AddControlModal to create new controls, disabled unless the panel is initialized and in edit mode, with tooltip feedback.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/De: A debug UI card that allows manually sending HTTP POST GPIO signals with configurable button number and on/off state, displaying the result of each request.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Dr: Wraps a control in an absolutely-positioned draggable container that tracks mouse events to update the control's x/y position via the layout hook when in edit mode.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Fu: A button that toggles fullscreen mode, showing enter/exit icons accordingly and displaying a toast error if fullscreen is unsupported or fails.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Im: A card panel providing export (download JSON) and import (paste JSON) functionality for the control layout, with validation error display and edit-mode gating.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/In: A sidebar inspector panel that displays and edits all properties of the currently selected control (id, label, position, size, type-specific codes and options), plus embeds the ImportExportPanel.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Mo: A toggle button that switches the panel between 'edit' and 'interact' modes using the usePanelMode hook, with corresponding icons and styling.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Re: Displays a scrollable list of recently emitted GPIO signals with control name, type, value, decimal code, and command string, with a refresh button and error alert.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Us: Renders a placeholder card UI section titled 'Custom Extensions' where users can add their own React components and custom functionality.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Wo: Renders the control panel workspace canvas, mapping controls to draggable/selectable ControlRenderer components and clearing selection when switching to interact mode.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useControlLayout.ts: Defines the ControlLayoutContext and exports the useControlLayout hook for accessing control panel state and operations like create, update, delete, and save.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullscreen.ts: Custom hook that manages fullscreen state for a given element ref, providing cross-browser enter, exit, and toggle fullscreen methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication via an AuthClient-backed React context, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status.
frontend/src/hooks/usePanelMode.ts: Module-level shared state hook that manages and persists the panel mode ('edit' or 'interact') using localStorage and useSyncExternalStore.
frontend/src/hooks/useRecentSignals.ts: Custom hook that polls the backend actor every 2 seconds to fetch and return recent signal events using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useSignalEmitter.ts: Custom hook that emits control signals by logging events to the ICP backend actor and optionally sending HTTP POST requests to a local GPIO server.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining Tailwind base styles, dark-theme CSS custom properties (oklch color tokens), control panel-specific styles, fullscreen layout rules, and custom scrollbar styling.
frontend/src/lib/buttonCode.ts: Provides utilities for validating, generating, and converting decimal button codes (1-16), including conversion to/from 4-bit binary strings.
frontend/src/lib/controlDefaults.ts: Returns default configuration objects for each control type and generates dual decimal codes for controls that require directional or on/off code pairs.
frontend/src/lib/download.ts: Exports a single utility function that triggers a browser download of a JSON object as a file.
frontend/src/lib/gpioHttp.ts: Sends a GPIO signal via HTTP POST to a local server at localhost:3000, with structured error handling for network and HTTP failures.
frontend/src/lib/gpiosetCommands.ts: Generates gpioset CLI command strings from decimal codes (1-16) by mapping 4-bit binary values to GPIO pins, and logs commands for control interactions.
frontend/src/lib/layoutSerialization.ts: Validates, exports, and imports control panel layout configurations as JSON, checking decimal codes, control types, positions, and sizes.
frontend/src/lib/safeBrowser.ts: Provides safe wrappers for browser APIs (localStorage, location, fullscreen) that gracefully handle unavailability or access errors.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a single `cn` helper that merges Tailwind CSS class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
Main screen component that renders the control panel UI with a header, workspace, and mode-dependent sidebars (inspector/extensions in edit mode, signals/debug in interact mode).
frontend/src/types/controlPanel.ts: Defines TypeScript types for control panel entities including ControlType, RadioOption, ControlConfig (with all decimal code variants), and LayoutConfig.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, box shadow, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration with React plugin, relative base path, environment variable plugins for CANISTER_ and DFX_ prefixes, and a `@` path alias pointing to src.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the GPIO Control Panel Linux application project, including existing features, pending feature requests, and architectural notes. Records versioned feature IDs, requirement mappings, and build/deployment goals for a Linux-targeted ICP frontend/backend stack.
